questions.q: Which four main object types live inside a Unity Catalog schema?
options: Catalogs, schemas, workspaces, and metastores
Tables, views, volumes, and functions (including registered models)
Dashboards, notebooks, jobs, and clusters
Only tables and views — volumes and models belong to the metastore directly
questions.explain: A schema's children are tables, views, volumes, and functions — the last category including versioned, registered ML models.

questions.q: What problem does a Unity Catalog volume solve?
options: It is only used for storing SQL warehouse logs
It replaces the need for a schema entirely
It stores table data faster than a managed table can
It governs non-tabular files (images, PDFs, raw CSVs) with a name, owner, and permissions, without forcing them into rows and columns
questions.explain: A volume is a governed, three-level-namespaced pointer to a directory of files in cloud storage — governance for files, not rows and columns.

questions.q: What must be true before Unity Catalog can draw a lineage connection between two objects?
options: Lineage is manually drawn by an admin; Unity Catalog does not track it automatically
Both objects must be in the same workspace, not just the same metastore
Both objects must be registered, governed objects in Unity Catalog
Only tables can appear in a lineage graph, never views or models
questions.explain: Lineage tracking depends on objects being registered with Unity Catalog in the first place — nothing gets traced unless it's a governed object.

questions.q: What is a governed tag used for?
options: Setting the physical storage location of a managed table
Renaming a catalog without dropping and recreating it
Granting SELECT privileges to a group
Key/value metadata (e.g. pii, Marketing) assigned to tables, schemas, volumes, or columns for classification and compliance tracking
questions.explain: Governed tags are key/value metadata used for classification or compliance (like marking a column as pii), assignable across tables, schemas, volumes, and columns.

questions.q: Which SQL statement creates a governed volume?
options: CREATE FILEGROUP finance.accounts_payable.invoice_pdfs;
CREATE VOLUME IF NOT EXISTS finance.accounts_payable.invoice_pdfs;
CREATE FOLDER finance.accounts_payable.invoice_pdfs;
NEW VOLUME finance.accounts_payable.invoice_pdfs;
questions.explain: CREATE VOLUME is the real Databricks SQL statement that registers a governed, three-level-namespaced volume.
